RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Tacoma operates under a Council-Manager form of government, which includes an elected Mayor and eight Council Members. The City Council consists of five Councilmanic districts and three at-large positions. The Mayor is also an elected official. The 'Position' numbers from search results were interpreted to correspond to the district and at-large structure, with Positions 1-5 assumed to be district-based and Positions 6-8 as at-large, consistent with Olgy Diaz being identified as an at-large member in Position 7.
